You are the instrument; the city is the drum.

Level 3: Siege Ascendant (BBTTCC)

Start of a Siege round you lead: first Maneuver costs −1 OP (min 1).

Level 3: Ramrunner Stance

Advantage to shove/push heavy objects; resist being moved while braced.

Level 6: Echo Breach

Once/round on structure hit, a second weak point takes force = PB.

Level 10: Overhang Sense

Pinpoint unstable surfaces; allies have advantage to avoid falling debris you call out.

Level 14: Momentum of Ruin

On breach success, allies within 30 ft gain temp HP = your level and advantage on next attack.
